date_basis: Date of the first public arXiv paper, not the checkpoint release date or conference year.
availability_definition: Yellow marks a verified authors-released trained checkpoint, including an official adapter or a released subset of model components. Public weights do not imply unrestricted use, fully released training data, or an open-source license. Plain labels denote a method/framework or no official checkpoint verified, not proof that weights cannot exist.
chronology_note: Representative selection, not exhaustive. Track membership is for reading and may overlap; links show chronology, not inheritance or performance superiority.

entries.name: CRNN
entries.availability_note: Official author implementation links the trained crnn_demo_model.t7; this is scene-text recognition, included as an enabling OCR precursor. The authors-linked Dropbox download returned HTTP 200 and an application/binary payload header (33,341,614 bytes) on the check date.

entries.name: Calamari
entries.availability_note: Official pretrained mixed-model repository is linked by the Calamari project.

entries.name: LayoutLM
entries.availability_note: Microsoft model repository exposes model.safetensors and pytorch_model.bin.

entries.name: TAPAS
entries.availability_note: Official Google implementation links pretrained checkpoints; official Google model repository exposes pytorch_model.bin.

entries.name: PP-OCR
entries.availability_note: Official release/1.1 model list preserves the original PP-OCR downloadable inference/training weights; this refers to PP-OCR weights, not code alone or later PP-OCR variants.

entries.name: LayoutLMv2
entries.availability_note: Official Microsoft repository exposes pytorch_model.bin.

entries.name: LayoutXLM
entries.availability_note: Official Microsoft repository exposes pytorch_model.bin.

entries.name: Donut
entries.availability_note: Official clovaai/donut implementation links this checkpoint; repository exposes pytorch_model.bin.

entries.name: LiLT
entries.availability_note: Official author repository provides downloadable LiLT-RoBERTa, LiLT-InfoXLM and layout-only checkpoints through OneDrive.

entries.name: LayoutLMv3
entries.availability_note: Official Microsoft repository exposes model.safetensors and pytorch_model.bin.

entries.name: Pix2Struct
entries.availability_note: Official Google implementation releases Base/Large checkpoints; Google model repository exposes safetensors and pytorch weights.

entries.name: UDOP
entries.availability_note: Official Microsoft implementation links author-hosted encoder/text-decoder checkpoints. Vision-decoder weights are not released; highlight does not claim every component is available.

entries.name: Qwen-VL
entries.availability_note: Official Qwen model repository exposes sharded pytorch weights.

entries.name: Table-GPT
entries.availability_note: Official release contains code and data for table-tuning GPT-3.5/ChatGPT. No authors-released standalone trained checkpoint verified; unrelated TableGPT models are not substituted.

entries.name: DocLLM
entries.availability_note: Author repository dongshengwang-ai/DocLLM contains paper/results but no official trained checkpoint was verified. Public third-party reimplementations do not satisfy this highlight criterion.

entries.name: mPLUG-DocOwl 1.5
entries.availability_note: Official X-PLUG implementation links the mPLUG model repository, which exposes safetensors and pytorch weights.

entries.name: GraphRAG
entries.availability_note: GraphRAG is a retrieval/indexing framework using configurable underlying language models, not a new standalone pretrained checkpoint.

entries.name: ColPali
entries.availability_note: Official illuin-tech/colpali repository links the paper checkpoint. Public trained adapter/projection weights are available; the PaliGemma base remains subject to its own access/license terms.

entries.name: Qwen2-VL
entries.availability_note: Official Qwen checkpoint repository exposes sharded safetensors.

entries.name: DocLayout-YOLO
entries.availability_note: Official implementation links this author-hosted DocStructBench checkpoint; repository exposes .pt weights.

entries.name: TableGPT2
entries.availability_note: Official TableGPT organization publishes 7B/72B checkpoints; TableGPT2-7B exposes safetensors.

entries.name: InternVL 2.5
entries.availability_note: Official OpenGVLab checkpoint repository exposes sharded safetensors.

entries.name: Qwen2.5-VL
entries.availability_note: Official Qwen checkpoint repository exposes sharded safetensors.

entries.name: olmOCR
entries.availability_note: Original official AllenAI February 2025 checkpoint exposes sharded safetensors; not substituted with the later olmOCR-2 model.

entries.name: SmolDocling
entries.availability_note: Original official DS4SD SmolDocling checkpoint exposes model.safetensors; not substituted with later Granite-Docling.

entries.name: MonkeyOCR
entries.availability_note: Official Yuliang-Liu/MonkeyOCR implementation links original recognition, relation and layout checkpoints.

entries.name: DeepSeek-OCR
entries.availability_note: Official DeepSeek checkpoint repository exposes safetensors.
